title: Respiratory Motion Phantom: low-cost MR-compatible pneumatic respiratory organ motion simulator
description: Open hardware (STL files, bill of materials, assembly guide) for a low-cost MR-compatible pneumatic respiratory organ motion simulator for MR-guided thermal therapy and motion-robust MRI development. Please cite Kim et al., Medical Physics 2022;49(7):4365-4371, doi:10.1002/mp.15783.
